find: if (mode === 'campaign-coop' || arenaGeometry === null) return { x: authored.x, y: authored.y };
replace: if (true) return { x: authored.x, y: authored.y };
why: respawnPos must actually reach pickVersusSpawnCell for ffa/teams -- forcing the fallback branch unconditionally (as if arenaGeometry were always absent) restores the campaign-coop-only behaviour for every mode. Caught by 5 of the 6 cases in versus-respawn.test.ts: every test that asserts a revived tank lands on the PICKED cell rather than its authored spawn. The one survivor is the dedicated fallback test itself (arenaGeometry genuinely absent), which asserts exactly the behaviour this mutation makes universal and so cannot tell the difference -- it is not blind to this mutation by accident, it is testing the state this mutation forces on every other case too.
